lens4_audits.public_summary: Across 9 dated Integrated Information Theory texts from 2004 to 2026, baseline Phi complexes and qualia space appear in 2004-2008 before Micah Blumberg 2011, followed by IIT 3.0 axioms, postulates, exclusion, and feed-forward contrasts (2014) and spatiotemporal coarse-graining (2016). Between December 2022 and April 2026, four later IIT 4.0+ components (formal causal distinctions and relations, stimulus-as-trigger endogenous intrinsic meaning, grid-based spatial/temporal/object rendering, and formal intrinsic macro-units) first join simultaneously in October 2025, while the newest April 2026 intrinsic-units paper specializes in binary macro-unit causal grain with timing invariance (contrasting with analog phase-differential timing). This private result is component-level and uncalibrated, credits 12 independent scientific lineages, and establishes no access, copying, derivation probability, or intent finding.
